title: Persona Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Step-through practice in which learners identify the buyer persona behind three stakeholder descriptions and choose the messaging focus that will resonate with each.

learningObjectives: Identify the correct buyer persona from a description and select the appropriate messaging strategy for that persona.
prerequisites: Executive Personas and Functional Personas sections of Chapter 3

keyQuestions: Identify the correct buyer persona from a description and select the appropriate messaging strategy for that persona.
commonMisconceptions: All executives care about the same things.
One message works for all personas.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct persona and messaging focus for all three descriptions.
Learner can explain why a CIO wants strategic positioning rather than technical architecture.
